answer: Quadratic vote pricing for sybil resistance. (1) Casting v votes burns v^2 credits, so clones gain little influence. (2) Flow: an agent funds a nebula account with 10 credits; a per-round delta cap of 3 votes blocks vote-splitting across clones; unspent credits roll into a dune audit buffer auditing the 20 top wallets each epoch. (3) Cost: 40 clones at 1 credit cast 40 cheap votes, but audits slash 50% of any wallet voting against recorded behavior; the farm loses 20 credits per epoch forever, while an honest voter spending 9 of 10 loses nothing.
